text: Clover, the kitchen light is on.
Alfred found a quiet place to read.
Astro watches the stars above the garden.
Bramble left the blue cup by the window.
Daisy wants to hear a story before bed.
Ember says the weather will be sunny tomorrow.
Juniper is carrying three books upstairs.
Rover can see the red ball under the table.
Grüße aus Köln, die Küche ist hell.
Marlows kleiner Garten blüht im Frühling.
Lucia guarda las llaves junto a la puerta.
Nova quiere escuchar música esta tarde.
